    Retractions #

    Definition 2.3 of the manuscript: for a k-linear functor Ψ : 𝒞 ⥤ Mod A, retractions for Ψ are k-linear maps ρ_{X,Y} : Hom(Ψ X, Ψ Y) → Hom(X, Y) compatible with composition and left inverse to Ψ. The domain 𝒞 is any k-linear category; in the applications it is D, D_fin, or a full subcategory such as C or C_fin.

    Retractions.KerChain R n f says that f is a composite of n composable maps lying in kernels of the retractions, and Retractions.NilpotentBound R n says that every such composite is zero.
